request.statement:
Process campaign state changes and report the reward clicks that navigate.

Submit one complete Rust program containing `fn main()`. Use only the standard library.

There are `N` rewards, `C` add-on categories, `A` distinct add-ons, and `Q` operations. Categories form a rooted forest. Category `c` is usable exactly when it and every ancestor are enabled. Initially every category is enabled.

Reward `i` has remaining quantity `r`, expiration time `e`, authorization bit `u`, compatible category `g`, and add-on requirement `k`. Category `0` means it has no compatible add-ons. An add-on has a category, stock, and expiration time.

At current time `t`, an add-on is available exactly when its stock is positive, its expiration is at least `t`, and its category is usable. It is compatible with reward `i` when its category is `g` or a descendant of `g`. Each available add-on counts once regardless of its stock amount.

A click on reward `i` navigates only while the campaign is live and exactly one of these rules applies:

- If `i` is not currently selected, `r>0`, `e>=t`, and `u=1`, it navigates in `BASE` mode.
- If `i` is currently selected, global add-ons are enabled, and at least `k` distinct compatible add-ons are available, it navigates in `ADDON` mode. Its base quantity, expiration, and authorization are ignored.

Otherwise it does nothing. Navigation does not change the selection or any other state.

Input:

- `N C A Q`
- `C` integers giving the parent of categories `1..C`; the parent of `c` is in `0..c-1`, where `0` denotes a root
- `N` lines: `r e u g k`
- `A` lines: `category stock expiration`
- One line: `t live addons selected`
- `Q` operations:
  - `T t`: set time; these values never decrease from the current time
  - `L b`: set the campaign-live flag
  - `G b`: set the global add-ons flag
  - `C c b`: set whether category `c` is enabled
  - `A a stock expiration`: replace add-on `a`'s stock and expiration
  - `R i r e u k`: replace reward `i`'s quantity, expiration, authorization, and add-on requirement
  - `S i`: set the selected reward; `i` may be `0`
  - `K i`: click reward `i`

Flags are `0` or `1`. IDs are 1-based except category and selection value `0`. Quantities and times are in `0..10^18`. Every `g` is in `0..C`, every `k` is in `1..A`, and `1<=N,C,A,Q<=200000` with `N+C+A+Q<=500000`.

Output the number of navigating clicks, followed in operation order by one line for each: its 1-based operation number, reward ID, and `BASE` or `ADDON`.

Output is compared by splitting on ASCII whitespace and matching tokens exactly.
